human_maps.import_policy: official escher/ JSON only via database.escher_diagram + diagram_modules; SVG/BY-SA excluded
human_maps.by_sa_note: Companion SVG exports under the Human-maps repository embed Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike (CC BY-SA) metadata and are NOT imported.
human_maps.canonicalization: Human-GEM reactions.tsv crosswalk → bigg.reaction / metanetx.reaction / rhea when annotated; MAR kept under human.gem

wikipathways_geometry.note: Default extension; loaded by database.modules(). Kept out of open_core.sqlite for size.

metabolismregulation.import_policy: gallery + atlas-downloads SBGN-ML via layout_atlas/sbgn.py + database.diagram_modules
metabolismregulation.attribution: Map diagrams and layouts: Metabolism Regulation project (https://metabolismregulation.github.io/gallery/), Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.

panther.import_policy: CellDesigner CD4.1 via celldesigner.decode + identity_labels + diagram_modules
panther.attribution: PANTHER Pathway (https://pantherdb.org/), Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International; CellDesigner maps from https://data.pantherdb.org/ftp/pathway/3.4/CD4.1/.

ich360.import_policy: custom Escher JSON via database.escher_diagram + diagram_modules; compressed_map.json excluded (CP pseudo-reactions)
ich360.dedupe_note: Include full_map + pathway_maps + pathways_not_in_model (10 maps). Exclude compressed_map (pseudo-reactions). Pathway maps are reaction-subsets of full_map but keep independent curated geometry; Atlas already retains overlapping drawings from one source (e.g. Human-maps compartment vs subsystem) and retrieval ranks them.
ich360.attribution: iCH360 Visualisation Escher maps (https://github.com/marco-corrao/iCH360), MIT License; Corrao et al., PLOS Computational Biology (doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1013564).
